Birdie Golf is a high-tech simulation game with futuristic design. Players putt balls into 10 triangular cups within 30 seconds per shot (10 rounds total). Higher scores earn better rewards. Popular among premium users since launch.



>> Features of Birde Golf Machine:


  • Time-Based Gameplay: Players must complete each putt within 30 seconds, promoting quick thinking and action.

  • Triangular Cup Design: Unique target shapes enhance difficulty and precision requirements.

  • 10-Round Format: Structured sessions provide clear goals and scoring opportunities.

  • Score-Reward System: Players are incentivized to improve their skills through a tiered reward system.

  • Futuristic Visuals: Sleek, modern design with LED lighting and stylish interface.

  • Interactive Display: Real-time scoring and performance feedback after each round.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Birde Golf Machine:


Skill Development: Enhances focus, putting accuracy, and timing under pressure.


Entertainment Value: Gamified golf experience attracts both beginners and seasoned players.


Space-Efficient Setup: Compact and stylish design fits well in luxury venues and indoor entertainment zones.

Revenue Generator: High replay value and reward structure encourage repeated play.


Versatile Use Cases: Perfect for malls, arcades, sports lounges, golf clubs, and interactive exhibitions.


Premium Experience: Appealing to high-end customers seeking leisure combined with challenge.



>> Product Number: LJST011


  • Floor area: 3.3m*1.4m*2m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-5 minutes

  • Power: 430w



>> FAQs for Birde Golf Machine:


Q1: How many shots does a player get per session?

A1: Each session consists of 10 rounds, with one shot per round (total of 10 shots).


Q2: What is the time limit for each shot?

A2: Players have 30 seconds to complete each putt.


Q3: How are scores calculated?

A3: Points are awarded based on accuracy and timing. Higher precision and faster shots yield better scores.


Q4: Are there different difficulty levels?

A4: The triangular cup design inherently adds complexity, but difficulty levels can be adjusted in premium setups.


Q5: What makes this suitable for commercial venues?

A5: Its eye-catching design, fast-paced gameplay, and reward-based motivation make it ideal for attracting customers and generating engagement.
